meta.title: Return
meta.description: In the future to come, an old friend returns from whence she came.

units.rawText: So, was it successful? After the logout? And then, and then?
units.displayText: So, was it successful? After the logout? And then, and then?

spans.text: So, was it successful? After the logout? And then, and then?

units.rawText: And then... when we woke up, that lazy professor over there was already chewing over the data.
units.displayText: And then... when we woke up, that lazy professor over there was already chewing over the data.

spans.text: And then... when we woke up, that lazy professor over there was already chewing over the data.

units.rawText: How are we feeling? I've located the biggest problem with this upload.
units.displayText: How are we feeling? I've located the biggest problem with this upload.

spans.text: How are we feeling? I've located the biggest problem with this upload.

units.rawText: Problem?
units.displayText: Problem?

spans.text: Problem?

units.rawText: Every issue comes from one key fact.
units.displayText: Every issue comes from one key fact.

spans.text: Every issue comes from one key fact.

units.rawText: The preparations we made before the upload were built on the assumption of Doll Data being commonly compatible. However, that's not quite the case...
units.displayText: The preparations we made before the upload were built on the assumption of Doll Data being commonly compatible. However, that's not quite the case...

spans.text: The preparations we made before the upload were built on the assumption of Doll Data being commonly compatible. However, that's not quite the case...

units.rawText: You mean that my neural cloud as a T-Doll is not of the same format as Dolls commonly found in Magrasea?
units.displayText: You mean that my neural cloud as a T-Doll is not of the same format as Dolls commonly found in Magrasea?

spans.text: You mean that my neural cloud as a T-Doll is not of the same format as Dolls commonly found in Magrasea?

units.rawText: Yes. Theoretically it holds up, but in practice, this backup of Magrasea is not compatible with T-Doll neural clouds developed later.
units.displayText: Yes. Theoretically it holds up, but in practice, this backup of Magrasea is not compatible with T-Doll neural clouds developed later.

spans.text: Yes. Theoretically it holds up, but in practice, this backup of Magrasea is not compatible with T-Doll neural clouds developed later.

units.rawText: Which is why that whole deal with the data happened, Magrasea automatically activated its measures to adjust you.
units.displayText: Which is why that whole deal with the data happened, Magrasea automatically activated its measures to adjust you.

spans.text: Which is why that whole deal with the data happened, Magrasea automatically activated its measures to adjust you.

units.rawText: How... was the impact really so severe?
units.displayText: How... was the impact really so severe?

spans.text: How... was the impact really so severe?

units.rawText: I don't exactly know what the circumstances were, but looking at the data fluctuations alone, you should have at the very least caused large-scale agent personality dissonance.
units.displayText: I don't exactly know what the circumstances were, but looking at the data fluctuations alone, you should have at the very least caused large-scale agent personality dissonance.

spans.text: I don't exactly know what the circumstances were, but looking at the data fluctuations alone, you should have at the very least caused large-scale agent personality dissonance.

units.rawText: But why don't we remember anything whatsoever?
units.displayText: But why don't we remember anything whatsoever?

spans.text: But why don't we remember anything whatsoever?

units.rawText: Forced logout, Commander. That type of impact makes you lose those memories.
units.displayText: Forced logout, Commander. That type of impact makes you lose those memories.

spans.text: Forced logout, Commander. That type of impact makes you lose those memories.

units.rawText: Of course, well, if some opportunity comes up... maybe you could recall a part of it?
units.displayText: Of course, well, if some opportunity comes up... maybe you could recall a part of it?

spans.text: Of course, well, if some opportunity comes up... maybe you could recall a part of it?

units.rawText: What counts as an "opportunity"?
units.displayText: What counts as an "opportunity"?

spans.text: What counts as an "opportunity"?

units.rawText: I don't know either, because we have no precedents. Maybe one day, when you've got no stories to tell, and you need to make some stuff up, it'll resurface.
units.displayText: I don't know either, because we have no precedents. Maybe one day, when you've got no stories to tell, and you need to make some stuff up, it'll resurface.

spans.text: I don't know either, because we have no precedents. Maybe one day, when you've got no stories to tell, and you need to make some stuff up, it'll resurface.

units.rawText: That's a bit too esoteric...
units.displayText: That's a bit too esoteric...

spans.text: That's a bit too esoteric...

units.rawText: Well, can you inspect the data we acquired from here?
units.displayText: Well, can you inspect the data we acquired from here?

spans.text: Well, can you inspect the data we acquired from here?

units.rawText: Not looking too good. Back to the compatibility issue, you almost burnt the servers to the ground when you were uploaded, and I couldn't monitor how things developed later.
units.displayText: Not looking too good. Back to the compatibility issue, you almost burnt the servers to the ground when you were uploaded, and I couldn't monitor how things developed later.

spans.text: Not looking too good. Back to the compatibility issue, you almost burnt the servers to the ground when you were uploaded, and I couldn't monitor how things developed later.

units.rawText: As a human you're still just too large of a block of data, and you were steps away from being torn to pieces so many times.
units.displayText: As a human you're still just too large of a block of data, and you were steps away from being torn to pieces so many times.

spans.text: As a human you're still just too large of a block of data, and you were steps away from being torn to pieces so many times.

units.rawText: But I was never torn up, was I?
units.displayText: But I was never torn up, was I?

spans.text: But I was never torn up, was I?

units.rawText: From the last place I could observe, 416 protected you with her own data, and was torn up in your place.
units.displayText: From the last place I could observe, 416 protected you with her own data, and was torn up in your place.

spans.text: From the last place I could observe, 416 protected you with her own data, and was torn up in your place.

units.rawText: Though the fact that's standing here proves that you managed to put her back together.
units.displayText: Though the fact that's standing here proves that you managed to put her back together.

spans.text: Though the fact that's standing here proves that you managed to put her back together.

units.rawText: All in all, 416 performed her protection duties to a satisfactory extent... But unfortunately, her neural cloud is not suitable for uploading together with you.
units.displayText: All in all, 416 performed her protection duties to a satisfactory extent... But unfortunately, her neural cloud is not suitable for uploading together with you.

spans.text: All in all, 416 performed her protection duties to a satisfactory extent... But unfortunately, her neural cloud is not suitable for uploading together with you.

units.rawText: She cannot enter the cloud safely, and we cannot guarantee that you can bring back useful data.
units.displayText: She cannot enter the cloud safely, and we cannot guarantee that you can bring back useful data.

spans.text: She cannot enter the cloud safely, and we cannot guarantee that you can bring back useful data.

units.rawText: ...Any other solutions?
units.displayText: ...Any other solutions?

spans.text: ...Any other solutions?

units.rawText: Or rather, could we use a neural cloud type more compatible for Magrasea...
units.displayText: Or rather, could we use a neural cloud type more compatible for Magrasea...

spans.text: Or rather, could we use a neural cloud type more compatible for Magrasea...

units.rawText: A Doll like that wouldn't have combat abilities anywhere close to 416...
units.displayText: A Doll like that wouldn't have combat abilities anywhere close to 416...

spans.text: A Doll like that wouldn't have combat abilities anywhere close to 416...

units.rawText: I remember our "projection replication" technology just got some results, right?
units.displayText: I remember our "projection replication" technology just got some results, right?

spans.text: I remember our "projection replication" technology just got some results, right?

units.rawText: I'd like to have a talk to the Tech Department. Ability is perhaps not the most important thing, but she must be a shadow reminiscent of a precious memory...
units.displayText: I'd like to have a talk to the Tech Department. Ability is perhaps not the most important thing, but she must be a shadow reminiscent of a precious memory...

spans.text: I'd like to have a talk to the Tech Department. Ability is perhaps not the most important thing, but she must be a shadow reminiscent of a precious memory...

units.rawText: I want to see... a new possibility.
units.displayText: I want to see... a new possibility.

spans.text: I want to see... a new possibility.

units.rawText: ...Professor, you remembered?
units.displayText: ...Professor, you remembered?

spans.text: ...Professor, you remembered?

units.rawText: I don't know... but it just came up in my mind.
units.displayText: I don't know... but it just came up in my mind.

spans.text: I don't know... but it just came up in my mind.

units.rawText: To have these desires, 416 in the cloud must have left one hell of an impression on me.
units.displayText: To have these desires, 416 in the cloud must have left one hell of an impression on me.

spans.text: To have these desires, 416 in the cloud must have left one hell of an impression on me.

units.rawText: <size=28>Oh, I don't know about that...</size>
units.displayText: Oh, I don't know about that...

spans.text: Oh, I don't know about that...

units.rawText: What?
units.displayText: What?

spans.text: What?

units.rawText: Cough. I mean... upload as you please. As your second-in-command, I'll protect you while you're uploaded.
units.displayText: Cough. I mean... upload as you please. As your second-in-command, I'll protect you while you're uploaded.

spans.text: Cough. I mean... upload as you please. As your second-in-command, I'll protect you while you're uploaded.

units.rawText: Please do come back with that replicated projection... And with that new memory.
units.displayText: Please do come back with that replicated projection... And with that new memory.

spans.text: Please do come back with that replicated projection... And with that new memory.

units.rawText: And that's the end.
units.displayText: And that's the end.

spans.text: And that's the end.

units.rawText: I see, I see... How incredibly interesting! Even though so many parts were difficult to understand!
units.displayText: I see, I see... How incredibly interesting! Even though so many parts were difficult to understand!

spans.text: I see, I see... How incredibly interesting! Even though so many parts were difficult to understand!

units.rawText: Professor, tell me, how much of that story was real, and how much was fiction.
units.displayText: Professor, tell me, how much of that story was real, and how much was fiction.

spans.text: Professor, tell me, how much of that story was real, and how much was fiction.

units.rawText: It's all made-up.
units.displayText: It's all made-up.

spans.text: It's all made-up.

units.rawText: Whaaaa? And you said seven parts real...
units.displayText: Whaaaa? And you said seven parts real...

spans.text: Whaaaa? And you said seven parts real...

units.rawText: A technique for improving immersion. Once, I conjured up a series of stories so good, the girl listening to me beat me up once I was done.
units.displayText: A technique for improving immersion. Once, I conjured up a series of stories so good, the girl listening to me beat me up once I was done.
